description.message: Adds the job offer you are reading, on any site, to your Indezy pipeline.

optionsHint.message: The address you open Indezy at, such as https://indezy.swirlit.dev. The extension reads nothing on the pages you visit: it hands Indezy the address of the page or link you choose, and fills a form only when you ask it to.

optionsInvalid.message: Enter an https:// address without a path.

menuFill.message: Fill this form with my Indezy profile

optionsToken.message: API token, to fill application forms (optional)

optionsTokenHint.message: A read-only token from Profile → Security → API tokens in Indezy, with nothing ticked under It reads. With it, Fill this form with my Indezy profile (right-click on a page) fills the form's empty name, email, phone, city, links, rate and availability fields; you check and send it yourself. Kept on this computer only.

fillNoToken.message: Add an API token in the extension's options to fill forms.

fillFailed.message: Indezy could not be reached with this token: check it in the options.

fillDone.message: $COUNT$ fields filled: check them, send the form, then save the opportunity in Indezy.

fillNothing.message: No field of this page could be filled.
